processLossCrossCutAudit.consistencyImpact: Each transformation output can become the next transformation input, so an unobserved local distortion may cascade through decomposition, routing, delegation, implementation, review, and acceptance into global end-to-end inconsistency; a final-looking artifact cannot alone prove chain fidelity.

a cumulative loss budget with downstream blast radius and rollback anchors
a falsifiable acceptance protocol spanning compression, handoff, delegation, routing, and lifecycle transforms
processLossCrossCutAudit.claimLimit: The report supplies bounded mechanism and measurement-design input. It does not prove the cited quantitative claims, a universal loss function, lossless continuation, end-to-end observability, or an effective Harness intervention.
